name: Ecommerce Performance Dashboard
prompt: make an interactive app that lists things to measure along the left, a large chart in the middle, and dimensions as filters above the chart. make the data oriented toward an ecommerce website

thought_process.interpretation: The user wants a high-fidelity, functional React dashboard for ecommerce analytics. It requires a vertical navigation for selecting metrics (measures), a central visualization area (Recharts), and horizontal filters for dimensions (Status, Category, Region). The app must use realistic mock data that aligns with the provided schema (order_items) and be fully interactive.
skills_utilized: Recharts (ComposedChart, Line, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer)
assumed_from_scratch: Product Categories (Electronics, Apparel, etc.) - required for meaningful ecommerce filtering
Geographic Regions (North America, Europe, etc.) - requested dimension for filters
200+ row dataset generation loop to simulate a real database response
State-driven filter logic to dynamically update chart and metric totals
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Create a 'Predictive Analytics' component using BQML-like logic to forecast the selected metric for the next 30 days based on the generated historical data.
